messages:
Eli: Quick FYI : Prospect WillowMed sent a consolidated security questionnaire + CAIQ excerpts (PDF attached). They want: SOC2 evidence, encryption/KMS details (BYOK), data residency in EU, and clarification on prompt retention. Requesting owner + ETA. Link: https://drive.example/willow-pack.pdf

Priya: I can take the control mappings and SOC2 artifacts. Immediate Q: is the POC expected to run on Hosted or Dedicated? BYOK only available on Dedicated/Private.

Kai: Solutions can own POC infra + staging access. We can spin a Dedicated trial (1x A10G) or provide a constrained Hosted demo. Dedicated provisioning ~48h after approval.

Eli: Customer preference: they prefer BYOK and EU residency. Also asked: "Are prompts/inputs persisted? If yes, for how long and where?"

Lina: If the data will include any patient data, legal will need DPIA and data processing agreement. Can you confirm data classification?

Eli: They say de-identified clinical notes for the POC, but may escalate. I'll ask and report back.

ops-bot: Intake created: ticket WM-2026-342. Status: open. Owner: unassigned.

Priya: Short answers we can provide now: - Default input/log retention: 30 days (configurable). - Hosted: no customer-managed KMS. - Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported via AWS KMS/GCP CMEK/Azure Key Vault & HSM. - EU residency: available on Dedicated/VPC Private. Lina: will need to approve DPA for de-identified vs PHI.

Kai: For staging SSO we support OIDC/SAML. Example (Okta):

```yaml
sso:
  protocol: oidc
  provider: okta
  redirect_uri: https://staging.willowmed.example/callback
```

Kai: Infra, please confirm BYOK integration checklist and ETA for account validation.

ops-bot: Ticket WM-2026-342 owner updated: Priya, Kai. Status: in_progress.

Priya: Action plan: 1) I'll draft questionnaire responses + attach SOC2 summary in ~3 business days. 2) Kai/infra to confirm BYOK integration details (1-2 business days). 3) Lina/legal to advise on DPIA if customer confirms PHI.

Lina: I'll queue a legal review; need precise data classification once Eli confirms. DPIA may add 5-7 business days if PHI is involved.

Eli: I'll confirm Hosted vs Dedicated and whether POC will include any PHI by EOD. Can we aim to return draft answers in 4 business days if Dedicated?

Priya: Yes, Dedicated path should allow ~4 business day turnaround. Hosted+full CAIQ would push to 10+ business days. Flagging timeline risk.

Eli: Noted. I'll update WillowMed and post back. Thanks team :thumbsup:
